$meta.name: desktop
$meta.note: The desktop application (Deep Signal) tenant, against the 2026-07 drafts. The dark palette converges deliberately on the same lineage as base(dark), one bloodline from logo to home to application, so there is no primitive override today. What makes the desktop distinct is not tokens but layout and components: the 232px sidebar, the constellation graph, glowing nodes, floating glass cards. When a divergence appears later (a brand font, a radius), add only the primitive leaf here. The View WebGL shades are generated by scripts/gen_theme_ts.py from viewScene in imports/figma-variables-*.json.
